tagline: HOLOSTARS English books its first concert. Kuzuha closes K-Arena's three-night run tonight. Baelz's first arena lottery expires at midnight. The week that started with three consecutive NIJISANJI concerts ends with three simultaneous deadlines.
inThisIssue: HOLOSTARS English 'First Light': all ten members, February 2027 online concert, the branch's first full live — t-shirt design contest through October 19
MECHATU-A 'Over Drive!' completed October 10 and Kuzuha closes the Yokohama K-Arena triple-header tonight with 'Bloody Alexandrite'
Hakos Baelz 'REGALIA' first ticket lottery expires tonight at midnight JST — December 1 at Kanadevia Hall, second window opens October 26

lead.title: HOLOSTARS English announces 'First Light' — all ten members, February 2027, the branch's first full concert after four years
lead.body: COVER Corporation announced on September 28 that HOLOSTARS English will hold its first full concert, 'First Light,' online in February 2027. All ten active members are performing: Regis Altare, Axel Syrios, Gavis Bettel, Machina X Flayon, Banzoin Hakka, Josuiji Shinri, Jurard T Rexford, Goldbullet, Octavio, and Crimzon Ruze. HOLOSTARS English debuted its first wave in July 2022, making 'First Light' the first time the full current roster has shared a concert stage — four years from first debut stream to first ensemble live. Exact dates and ticket pricing are listed as to be announced on the official site at first-light.hololivepro.com; the hashtag is #FirstLight2027. Alongside the announcement, COVER launched a fan-submitted t-shirt design contest using chibi illustrations of all ten members. The winning shirt will be worn during the concert. Submissions close October 19. HOLOSTARS JP has held multiple concerts across its history; 'First Light' establishes the first comparable milestone for the English branch and represents a structural investment the JP side of the HOLOSTARS roster has had for years. The t-shirt contest is an unusual production detail — the shirt is not pre-designed, it is being commissioned from the fandom — and the community read is that COVER wants the concert's merch to feel specifically authored by the people who showed up every stream. Fourteen days left to submit a design. Everything else about the show is TBA.

stories.title: Hakos Baelz 'REGALIA' 1st Concert — first ticket lottery closes tonight at midnight JST, second window opens October 26, show December 1 at Kanadevia Hall
stories.blurb: Hakos Baelz's first solo concert 'REGALIA' is set for December 1 at Kanadevia Hall in Tokyo. The first venue ticket lottery via Zaiko expires today at 23:59 JST; the second application window opens October 26. Arena standing tickets are 11,500 yen; an early-entry arena tier at 16,000 yen includes a pre-show fan meet. A live stream runs simultaneously on ZAIKO and SPWN. Baelz announced the show during her fifth anniversary stream in August alongside her forthcoming second album 'Mirror Mirror.' Kanadevia Hall seats approximately 1,900 in its main configuration, her largest solo venue booking. Tonight's lottery deadline is the hard calendar moment for anyone who wants a venue ticket at first-price.

stories.title: MECHATU-A 'Over Drive!' debut live completed October 10 at K-Arena Yokohama — the 8-member NIJISANJI unit's first concert went off as announced, triple-header closes tonight with Kuzuha
stories.blurb: MECHATU-A ran their debut concert 'Over Drive!' at K-Arena Yokohama on Saturday October 10, completing the unit's first live event three months after their mini album 'On-Deck!' in July. Asia theater live viewings ran concurrently in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand. Kenmochi Doanya followed Sunday October 11 with his solo live 'Kokuu Kyouen.' Kuzuha closes the three-night K-Arena run tonight with 'Bloody Alexandrite,' featuring guests Kenmochi Toya, Fuwa Minato, Ibrahim, and Lauren Iroas; doors 16:30, show 18:00 JST, Niconico streaming at dwango-ticket.jp. The sequence — an eight-member unit debut live, a solo live, and an arena headliner, back to back to back at the same Yokohama complex — is the first time NIJISANJI has run three consecutive nights at K-Arena, and the triple-header ends tonight.

stories.title: Phase Saga one-year anniversary is October 25 — thirteen days, Phase Connect still dark, @Filian_VT1 is DEBUT DELAYED Week 19
stories.blurb: Phase Connect's Phase Saga generation (Clio Aite, Mari Mari, Eepy Sleepy) reaches one year on October 25. As of today that is thirteen days away. Phase Connect has posted nothing tied to the anniversary. @Filian_VT1 is in Week 19 of DEBUT DELAYED. The pre-debut behavioral-tell analysis holds at two of three Phase Connect indicators confirmed; the third indicator — an account quiet period of approximately eleven days before a Phase Connect debut announcement — has not started. If it starts this week, the math resolves to October 24, one day before the Phase Saga anniversary. The community is not calling October 25 as the debut date specifically, but it is the date Phase Connect will need to speak around one way or another. Thirteen days.

stories.title: NIJISANJI EN 'Secret Favor Voice' on sale October 6 — the EN branch is in post-nijiFAN Talk quiet period with no wave announcement
stories.blurb: NIJISANJI EN released 'Secret Favor Voice' on October 6, available via the official NIJISANJI EN store. The voice pack follows 'Take it Easy Voice' from August. The nijiFAN Talk vol.6 second-weekend window (October 3-4) — the community's leading candidate for an Immersion-Focused Male audition shortlist announcement — closed without public confirmations. The community tracker adjusted its probability estimate but maintains that shortlist contacts under NDA remain the expected pattern; NIJISANJI EN has not historically confirmed shortlist contacts at any stage before a reveal. A minority theory that was gaining ground last week — that an announcement would be staged as a post-show surprise during 'Bloody Alexandrite' on October 12 — now resolves tonight. No announcement in that window means the next identifiable window is currently unspecified.

stories.title: NAWASENA 3rd generation set to debut this October — MooMi Latte, Kukuryu, and Matchuan bring the Indonesian agency to ten active members
stories.blurb: Indonesian VTuber agency NAWASENA announced its third generation across August and September, with three new members — MooMi Latte, Kukuryu, and Matchuan — set for October debuts. The introductions were posted to NAWASENA's official X account through September; debut dates were listed as to be announced. The third generation brings the agency's total active roster to ten members. NAWASENA's October launch runs alongside the HRCOME disband — the Indonesian agency ceased operations September 21 with five talents continuing independently — and the NAWASENA debut class absorbs some of the attention those departures freed up in the Indonesian-language VTuber community. Debut tracking and schedule at x.com/Nawasena_Live.

indieSubhead: NO AGENCY, NO PROBLEM — NEWS FROM THE SELF-MADE CORNER OF THE SCENE

indies.title: HRCOME disbanded September 21 — five Indonesian VTubers continuing independently after two years of agency operation
indies.blurb: Indonesian VTuber agency HRCOME ceased operations on September 21, 2026, after approximately two years active. All five remaining talents are continuing their careers as independent VTubers. The HRCOME disbanding adds five more working independents to the Indonesian-language VTuber scene at the same time NAWASENA's third generation is launching its debut cycle. The Indonesian VTuber space has had several agency entries and exits in 2026 — consolidation is visible at the mid-tier level, with talents redistributing toward independence or toward the agencies that have demonstrated stability. Indonesian VTuber scene reporting at kaorinusantara.or.id.

indies.title: October indie debut class runs into the densest agency event week of Q4 — the K-Arena three-night run closed the first full weekend
indies.blurb: The October indie debut window opened concurrently with the MECHATU-A K-Arena debut live on October 10 and the Kuzuha triple-header run closing tonight. The Q4 event density — three consecutive NIJISANJI nights, Suisei Kobe on October 21, Phase Saga anniversary October 25 — compresses the clear post-event discovery windows that have historically driven above-baseline indie first-stream numbers. The window after October 12 is the first clean break in the calendar since September; debuts scheduled for the week of October 13-19 have the first K-Arena-free run since Q3 closed. October debut cohort tracking at hololist.net.

tea.text: The /vt/ Bloody Alexandrite thread has been running since the Asia theater viewings opened and the live reporting chain is active. The pre-show discussion revolved around whether the post-concert Street Fighter casting confirmation — if it came up on stage or in a post-show clip — would complete or re-open the 'arc is perfect' debate the fandom had been running since September. The thread referee preemptively issued a ruling that any stage reference to Kuzuha voicing Marvin counts as arc confirmation and that re-opening the debate after that point requires new evidence, not enthusiasm. The ruling was issued before the show. Nobody disagreed. The thread waiting for the confirmation post is currently seven pages ahead of the thread that is watching the show.

The NIJISANJI EN wave speculation thread updated its taxonomy after the Bloody Alexandrite post-show surprise theory resolved without an announcement. Camp A's Tuesday-Wednesday dead-period slot is now the consensus leading candidate. Camp B's voice-pack-precedes-debut pattern is still being tracked but the window is widening — Secret Favor Voice (October 6) is six to eight weeks before a late-November or early-December reveal under the historical spacing, and early December is now the Camp B midpoint. The tracker maintainer added: 'I updated the methodology. I still have no idea. The methodology is now more sophisticated in how it does not know.' The thread awarded this entry the tracker's best annotation of the quarter. The wave is still not announced.

The HOLOSTARS English First Light t-shirt contest thread split in predictable directions within 48 hours of the announcement. The dominant faction is producing ensemble pieces with all ten members. The second faction is producing designs that feature Gavis Bettel at a size the submission guidelines do not technically prohibit. The third faction submitted a design where all ten members are arranged alphabetically and is arguing that this constitutes the most defensible interpretation of 'fan expression.' COVER's submission guidelines do not address alphabetical order as a creative choice. The chibi illustration set apparently lists the members in a non-alphabetical order that the third faction has decided is morally incorrect. October 19 is the deadline. The alphabetical question is going to the wire.

The Filian quiet-period tracker posted its most-upvoted entry of the DEBUT DELAYED run this week. The math: if the third pre-debut behavioral indicator (an approximately eleven-day account quiet period) starts on October 13, it resolves to October 24 — one day before the Phase Saga anniversary. The thread noted that this either means Phase Connect is running the exact timing sequence the community has been predicting since August, or the community has been pattern-matching on a dataset of four prior waves and is now retroactively fitting the shape to the calendar. The tracker maintainer's response: 'Both of these things can be true simultaneously and I find that deeply funny.' The entry got 1,200 upvotes. The quiet period has not started. Tomorrow is October 13.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday, 19 October — the HOLOSTARS English t-shirt contest closes that day, the Phase Saga anniversary is six days out, and Suisei's Kobe show is two days away. One week closer to all of it. See you in seven.
